title: No sapateiro do bairro
grammar: Could I + verbo para pedir educadamente
reading: Ben has old leather boots.
They are antique boots from his grandfather.
The sole has a big hole, and the heel is loose.
Ben takes the boots to Mr. Silva's shop.
Mr. Silva fixes them with glue and a nail.
Now the boots are good as new.
dialogue: Hello, Mr. Silva. Look at my antique boots.
Oh, the sole has a big hole!
Yes, and the other boot is fine. Could I leave them here?
Sure. I can fix them with glue and a nail today.
Really? Is it a big job?
No problem. Read a newspaper here, or come back at five.
Thank you. Could I pay you now? I have twenty dollars.
Pay later, please. Every old boot has a story, and yours is going to be good as new.

title: Escolhendo um hamster no pet shop
grammar: Could you + verbo para pedir ajuda
reading: Lia wants a pet hamster.
She goes to a pet shop with her dad.
The hamsters are small and soft, with tiny tails.
One hamster runs on a wheel in its cage.
It is hard to pick one out.
Lia gets the brown one and a red collar for her dog.
dialogue: Hi! I want a hamster. Could you help me pick one out?
Sure. This brown one is very friendly and soft.
Oh, it's so tiny! Could you open the cage, please?
Of course. Be careful. Its tail is short, but it runs fast.
Really? It is on the wheel now. A dream pet!
Great. It needs seeds and a bowl. Do you have a bowl at home?
No, I don't. Could you show me one? And I need a collar for my dog.
Sure. Here you are. The leather collar is a bargain today.

title: Consertando o relógio de pulso
grammar: Can e could com please; respostas Sure e Sorry
reading: Tom has an antique watch from his grandfather.
The leather strap is old, and the glass is broken.
He walks down the street to a small shop.
The man opens the back and looks at the gear.
He cleans the dirty dial and winds it up.
Tick, tock! The watch works, and it is good as new.
dialogue: Good morning. Can you fix my antique watch, please?
Sorry, I'm busy now. Could you come back at four?
Sure. Look, the glass is broken and it doesn't tick.
I see. There is a problem with the gear too.
Really? The strap is new. It was a bargain.
Don't worry. I can clean the dial and wind it up for you.
Thank you. I am going to come back at four.
Sure. Here you are. Now it is good as new, and it works.

title: Exame de vista na ótica
grammar: Could we + verbo e Could I have + substantivo
reading: Mia and her brother Noah go to a glasses shop.
Her eyesight is bad, and the small letters look blurry.
The doctor checks her eyes with a bright light.
Then Mia tries on many frames in the mirror.
She picks red frames and a leather case.
Now her future looks bright!
dialogue: Hi. My eyesight is bad. Could you check my eyes, please?
Sure. Read the small letters on the wall.
I can read the big letters, but the small ones are blurry.
I see. You need glasses. Look at these frames.
I like the red ones. Could we try them in the mirror? My brother is here.
Of course. They look great on you.
Could I have a leather case too, please? It is a dream pair!
Sure. Here you are. They are going to be ready on Friday.

title: Cachorro doente no veterinário
reading: Rosa's dog Max is sick today.
He doesn't eat, and his paw is red.
Rosa takes him to the vet.
The vet gives Max a vaccine and some medicine.
"He should take it easy for three days," says the vet.
At home, Max wears his collar and watches the hamster cage.
dialogue: Hello! My dog Max is sick. He doesn't want his food.
I see. His eyesight is good, but his paw is red and he is tired.
Oh no. Is it serious?
No, it isn't. He should rest at home and take it easy for three days.
Really? Can he go out to play?
Only a little. He should drink water and take his medicine.
OK. And could I have a new collar for him, please?
Sure. Here you are. He needs a vaccine today, and you should call me tomorrow.

title: Cuidados no deserto
grammar: Shouldn't para dizer o que não se deve fazer
reading: Lia and her uncle visit a big desert.
The sand is hot, and the sun is strong.
A camel walks slowly near a tall cactus.
"Watch your step!" says Uncle Tom.
A snake sleeps under the rocks.
They wear hats and leather boots, and they take it easy.
dialogue: Wow, the desert is so big and quiet!
Yes, but it is hot. You shouldn't walk in the sun without a hat.
I have my hat. Look, a cactus! Can I touch it?
No! You shouldn't touch the cactus. And watch your step, too.
Why? Is there a snake here?
Maybe. We shouldn't go near the rocks. Look at the camel instead.
Cool! The sole of my leather boots is hot. Can we take it easy for a minute?
Sure. Sit down here, and drink some water.

title: Equipamento para a escalada
reading: Noah and Ana want to climb a mountain.
They check their gear at a sports shop.
The man shows a harness, a helmet, and a long rope.
Ana puts on the harness and pulls the strap tight.
The summit looks far away, with a big boulder in the way.
"Take it easy, and we can reach the top," says Noah.
dialogue: Excuse me. I want to climb a mountain. Should I wear gloves?
Yes, you should. And you should take a helmet too.
Good idea. Should I buy my own rope today?
No, we have ropes here. Try this harness, please. Is it tight?
It feels good. Is the summit far from here?
Yes, it is, but you can reach the top in four hours. Take it easy and watch your step.
Great. Should I go with a friend?
Yes, you should. Please don't go alone.

title: Aula de ioga ao amanhecer
grammar: Revisão: could e should em pedidos e conselhos
reading: Mia goes to a yoga class at sunrise.
The instructor is a kind woman named Rosa.
Mia has her gear in a bag and puts her mat on the floor.
First, the class does the camel pose.
"Close your eyes and breathe slowly," says Rosa.
Mia finds her balance and feels calm.
dialogue: Good morning! I'm new in this yoga class. Could you help me with the mat?
Sure. Put it here, and sit down. Are you OK?
A little nervous. My balance isn't good.
Don't worry. You should breathe slowly and take it easy.
OK. Can I ask something? What do I do with my eyes?
Close your eyes and feel the floor. The pose is hard, but you are doing great.
Wow, it works! Could we do the camel pose again?
Sure, you can. Your balance is good now, and you look calm.

title: Uma erupção na ilha
grammar: There was e there were afirmativo
reading: Last summer, Tom and his father visited an island.
There was a big volcano near the beach.
There were black rocks and a deep crater at the summit.
There was smoke, and red lava ran down the hill.
A loud noise came, and a boulder fell.
Everyone left the beach, and nobody got hurt.
dialogue: Dad, look at the volcano! There was a lot of smoke this morning.
I saw it. There were red lights in the sky last night too.
Really? Was the lava near the beach?
No, it wasn't. But there was a loud noise at the summit.
Did a big boulder fall?
Yes, it did. Please run for cover fast, and watch your step.
OK, Dad. I'm going to stay close to you.
Good. We are going to leave the island at six.

title: Espetáculo sob a lona
reading: Last night, Ben and his mom went to the circus.
There was a big red tent with bright lights.
There wasn't a lion, but there was a camel.
There weren't any seats in front, so they stood.
The acrobat flew to the trapeze, and the juggler threw five balls.
Everyone clapped, and the clown ran away.
dialogue: Mom, the show was amazing! The acrobat did yoga on the trapeze.
I loved it. But there wasn't a net under him!
Right! And look, the juggler is going to jump on that big ball.
There weren't any lions today, though. I wanted to see one.
Yes, but there was a camel, and it could balance a hat.
Oh yes! And there wasn't any rain tonight, so we walked here.
Look, the acrobat is going to take a bow now.
Yes! Clap your hands, Ben. It was a great night.

title: Um dia de pesca no rio
reading: Tom and Lia sat on a big boulder by the stream.
The valley was green and very quiet.
Tom put a worm on the hook for bait.
Lia threw the line from her rod into the water.
A fish came to the bait, and Lia caught it in her net.
She thought it was big, but it was small.
dialogue: Noah, tell me about your day at the stream.
It was great! We sat on a big boulder all morning.
Nice. My yoga class is boring, and fishing sounds better.
My dad threw the line, and a big fish came fast.
Wow! So he caught it, right?
No, I caught a tiny one. Fishing is good for balance too.
That sounds fun. Can I come next Saturday?
Sure. Bring a hat, and I have an extra rod for you.

title: Por dentro da fábrica de chocolate
reading: Mia visited a chocolate factory with her class.
A worker gave her a small gold wrapper.
She found a big mold with a star shape.
The worker put oil in the mold, and the warm chocolate ran in.
The timer was on for five minutes, so Mia waited.
She felt happy, and she could write her name on the wrapper.
dialogue: Mia, tell me about the factory!
It was huge! The chocolate looked like lava from a volcano.
Really? What were the workers like?
They ran between the big machines all day.
Wow. Was the chocolate good?
Yes! A man gave me a piece, and I felt so happy.
Lucky you! I want a gold wrapper too.
No problem. I found two, so you can have one.

title: Lance final no leilão
reading: Rosa went to an auction with her uncle.
A man sold an old painting and a silver ring.
Rosa raised her hand with a bid for a small crown.
The man said, "Going once!" and then he used the gavel.
Rosa won the crown, and her uncle paid for it.
They left happy, and the sword stayed on the table.
dialogue: Rosa, was the auction fun on Saturday?
Yes! It was loud like a circus, and the man with the gavel moved like an acrobat.
Really? Was the old painting expensive?
A woman paid fifty dollars for it. She won.
Wow. And the sword? Was it cheap?
Yes, a man from a shop in the old alley sold it.
I felt tired and left early, but my uncle stayed.
Great. Next time, take me with you, please.

title: Maratona de videogame
reading: Ben and Lia put the dice away and play a game on the console.
Lia holds the controller, and Ben watches the screen.
Level two is more difficult than level one.
The new monster is more dangerous than the first enemy.
Lia gets an extra life, and her score goes up.
Ben says this game is more fun than chess.
dialogue: Give me the controller, Lia. It's my turn now.
Sure. Did you finish level two yesterday?
No, I didn't. Level two is more difficult than level one.
Really? I won it in ten minutes.
Look! The new monster is more dangerous than the first enemy.
Careful, Ben. It's your move, and the extra life is on the left.
Got it! I'm winning now. Is this game more fun than chess?
Yes, it is! I love this console.

title: O livro dos recordes
reading: Tom has a big book of world records.
Mia reads it with him on the sofa.
This skyscraper is the tallest building in the world.
The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world.
The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
Mia says the Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean.
dialogue: Tom, look at this page. Is it a new record?
Yes. This tower is the tallest building in the world.
Wow. I want to see it. Is it near the ocean?
No, but there is a ferry to the ocean. Wear a life jacket there!
Ha ha. What is the fastest animal in the world?
The cheetah. A scientist says it runs faster than a car.
Is the whale the biggest animal in the world?
Yes, it is! A giant whale is bigger than a bus.

title: Revisão: Cabine de fotos
grammar: Revisão: comparativos, superlativos, who, how e irregulares
reading: Ana and Ben found a photo booth at the mall.
They paid two dollars and sat inside.
Ben made the funniest face.
Ana gave a big grin and made a pose.
The booth gave them a long strip of photos.
Ana's grin was bigger than Ben's, but his face was funnier.
dialogue: Who made the funniest face in the booth, Ana?
You did! How did you do that? I almost lost my sticker!
I thought about the ferry on Sunday. It was the slowest ride in the world!
Ha ha! We can take one more photo. Do you have a dollar?
Yes, I do. Here you are. This strip is longer than the first one. Don't lose it!
Great. Your move, Ben. Make a pose and give a big grin.
Done! Is my grin bigger than your grin?
Yes, it is! It's a new record for this booth!

title: Ensaio da orquestra
reading: Emma plays the cello in a school orchestra.
Jack plays the trumpet, and Lia plays the flute.
The teacher says, "Today is a rehearsal."
The harp and the bass sit at the back.
Emma holds her bow with a big grin.
At the end, everyone claps.
dialogue: Hi, Emma. You have a new sticker on your cello case.
Yes, it's a gift from my aunt. It's the biggest sticker in the shop.
The teacher is here. We must sit down now.
Okay. Did you bring the music, Jack?
Yes, I did. We must read the music on page five.
Good. The trumpet must be loud, and the flute must be soft.
That's easy. We can play it one more time.
Yes, we can. I love this orchestra.

title: Revisão: Dia de esqui
reading: Noah and Mia are on the mountain today.
They have ski boots, and Mia has a thick fabric jacket.
The sky is blue, and the slope is white.
First, they take the lift to the top.
Noah is a beginner, so he must go down slowly.
Noah says, "I can do it myself!"
dialogue: Mia, I must wear a helmet on the slope, right?
Yes, you must. Put on your gloves and plastic goggles too.
Okay. I have a few snacks in a cardboard box. Do you want one?
Sure, thanks. Just one, because I want to ski well today.
Look at the sky! It is so blue today.
Wow, beautiful. Now, you must go down slowly. Speed is dangerous.
Really? Okay. I can do it myself, but please stay near me.
No problem. I stay next to you all day, and we make a snowman later.

title: Primeira aula de surfe
reading: Ben is at the beach for his first surf lesson.
He wears a black wetsuit and holds a big surfboard.
The coach says, "Paddle hard, Ben!"
A wave comes, and Ben can stand up fast.
Ben surfs to the shore by himself.
He feels very proud of himself.
dialogue: Look, Tom! Ben is in the water with his surfboard.
He looks nervous. Is there a shark here?
No, of course not! The coach is with him, so he is safe.
Good. Did Ben put on his wetsuit himself? The fabric is thick.
Yes, he did it himself. He can float on the board now.
Look! He paddles, and he stands up fast!
Amazing! The kids over there teach themselves, but Ben has a coach.
Yes, he is lucky. Last winter he learned to ski on a slope, and now he surfs!

title: Jogo de hóquei no gelo
reading: Noah and Tom play hockey at the rink.
Tom is the goalie, and he holds a big stick.
When the puck stops, Noah skates fast.
When Noah shoots, Tom blocks the shot.
The puck does not go in the net.
When the game ends, the score is one to one.
dialogue: Ben, are you ready for the hockey game?
Yes! I hold my stick tight when I skate. I used sandpaper on it.
Good. Please block the shot when the puck comes to you.
Sure. I am the goalie, so I stay near the net.
Look! The other team has the puck. The volume of the crowd is loud!
Okay! When he shoots, I move to the left.
Great save! You blocked the shot!
Yes, I did! The score is still zero to zero, so let's sing karaoke later.

title: Colhendo na horta comunitária
grammar: And e but para juntar ideias
reading: Rosa has a plot in the community garden.
She has a spade, and she has good compost.
The lettuce is ripe and ready, but the radishes are small.
Rosa notices some weeds, but she has no gloves.
She plants new seeds, and a worm moves in the dirt.
Rosa is tired but happy, so she takes a nap.
dialogue: Tom, come here! Look at my lettuce. It is bigger than a hockey puck!
Wow, it is so big! Is it ripe and ready?
Yes, it is ready, but the radishes are still small.
Do you have a spade? I want to dig here.
Yes, I have two. One is old, but it works well.
Great. I have compost, and I have seeds too.
Nice! I notice weeds near the fence. I want to pull them.
Sure, I can help you with the weeds right now.

title: Lavando o carro
grammar: Mistura de and, but, so e because
reading: Tom and Mia wash the car on Sunday.
The car is dirty, so Tom gets the foam.
Tom takes the foam, and he can spray it on.
Mia rinses the car, and the dirt goes away.
They have wax, but the rag is wet, so Mia gets a dry one.
Now the car has a nice shine, and they are happy.
dialogue: Mia, the car is very dirty, so let's wash it.
Good idea. Where is the foam?
It is in the box next to the spade and the compost.
Here it is. I spray it on, and you rinse it.
Okay. Look at all the bubbles!
Fun! We need wax too, because we want a nice shine.
The wax is here, but I can't find a clean rag.
I have one in the box. Yes, now it is perfect. Time for a nap!

title: Arrumando o sótão
reading: Tom and Mia go up to the attic to clear it out.
Mia held the lantern, and Tom found an old box.
Inside, there was a gold ring, a small crown and a toy sword.
Tom kept the ring in his hand.
Mia told Tom about a pearl chain that she lost.
A tiny ant walked over the cobweb, and they laughed.
dialogue: Tom, did you find the photo album yet?
No, I lost it. I held it ten minutes ago.
Look behind the old dog kennel. I think I saw it there.
Here it is! And there is a box of arrows too.
Cool. Grandpa told me he kept his old visa inside the album.
Really? Let me see. Yes, the visa is here, and it has a stamp.
That is great. Can you hold the lantern, please?
Sure. Here you are. The attic looks better now.
